_about: vmrun error texts and the error code VmrunCli must map them to. source: 'captured' = printed by vmrun 1.17.0 on this host (see captures.json); 'task' = quoted in the feature spec as real output; 'vix-unverified' = VIX/VMware wording known from documentation/forums that could NOT be captured safely (it needs a real VM state change) - treat these as best-effort until Phase 0 captures them; 'synthetic' = made-up guest-side texts that guard against over-broad classification needles.
